content.tex: B MODELLING (QUESTIONS 8 TO 11)
AIRPORT RUNWAY (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This task looks at the factors that affect the decision to build a second runway at an airport.
The factors are: \(\bullet\) the number of seconds a plane waits over the airport before it can start to land \(\bullet\) the number of seconds it then takes to land.
A plane cannot begin to land until the runway is free but must wait over the airport. As soon as the runway is free the plane begins to land.

The number of seconds between one plane and the next plane arriving over the airport is called the \(inter-arrival\) time. The number of seconds from when a plane begins to land and when it stops is called the landing time.
